paper_version.title: FIRE-Bench: Evaluating AI Agents on the Rediscovery of Scientific Insights

official_code_version.snapshot_scope: Selected inference-time method, runtime, configuration, example, evaluation, and test files; 64 files retained. Training paths, datasets, model weights, generated outputs, credentials, benchmark answers, and files larger than 1 MB are excluded.

excluded_trainable_objects: task-specific neural router, compressor, guard, verifier, or policy
integration_screening.selected_artifact_scope: We introduce FIRE-BENCH (Full-cycle Insight Rediscovery Evaluation), which instead asks agents to rediscover established, verifiable findings from recent, high-impact machine learning research.
integration_screening.basis: The retained artifact is an inference-time harness, memory, retrieval, scheduling, security, observability, or executable evaluation mechanism. Model-training branches and trained task-specific components are outside this packet boundary.

benchmark_leakage_check.task_template_boundary: Datasets, task instances, annotations, answers, generated runs, and result directories are excluded from the selected code snapshot.
